title: Happy Tree Party
statementMd:
Bogdan has a birthday today and mom gave him a tree consisting of $*n*$ vertecies. For every edge of the tree $*i*$, some number $*x*_{*i*}$ was written on it. In case you forget, a tree is a connected non-directed graph without cycles. After the present was granted, $*m*$ guests consecutively come to Bogdan's party. When the $*i*$-th guest comes, he performs exactly one of the two possible operations:

1. Chooses some number $*y*_{*i*}$, and two vertecies $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$. After that, he moves along the edges of the tree from vertex $*a*_{*i*}$ to vertex $*b*_{*i*}$ using the shortest path (of course, such a path is unique in the tree). Every time he moves along some edge $*j*$, he replaces his current number $*y*_{*i*}$ by ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a185f1c5e3a23a089bf689d964cc2d081c9f40ce.png), that is, by the result of integer division $*y*_{*i*}$ div $*x*_{*j*}$.
2. Chooses some edge $*p*_{*i*}$ and replaces the value written in it $*x*_{*p*_{*i*}}$ by some positive integer $*c*_{*i*} < *x*_{*p*_{*i*}}$.

As Bogdan cares about his guests, he decided to ease the process. Write a program that performs all the operations requested by guests and outputs the resulting value $*y*_{*i*}$ for each $*i*$ of the first type.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integers, $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of vertecies in the tree granted to Bogdan by his mom and the number of guests that came to the party respectively.

Next $*n* - 1$ lines contain the description of the edges. The $*i*$-th of these lines contains three integers $*u*_{*i*}$, $*v*_{*i*}$ and $*x*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$, $1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{18}$), denoting an edge that connects vertecies $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$, with the number $*x*_{*i*}$ initially written on it.

The following $*m*$ lines describe operations, requested by Bogdan's guests. Each description contains three or four integers and has one of the two possible forms:

- $1$ $*a*_{*i*}$ $*b*_{*i*}$ $*y*_{*i*}$ corresponds to a guest, who chooses the operation of the first type.
- $2$ $*p*_{*i*}$ $*c*_{*i*}$ corresponds to a guests, who chooses the operation of the second type.

It is guaranteed that all the queries are correct, namely

1 ≤ *a*<sub>*i*</sub>, *b*<sub>*i*</sub> ≤ *n*

,

1 ≤ *p*<sub>*i*</sub> ≤ *n* - 1

,

1 ≤ *y*<sub>*i*</sub> ≤ 10<sup>18</sup>

and

1 ≤ *c*<sub>*i*</sub> < *x*<sub>*p*<sub>*i*</sub></sub>

, where

*x*<sub>*p*<sub>*i*</sub></sub>

represents a number written on edge

*p*<sub>*i*</sub>

at this particular moment of time that is not necessarily equal to the initial value

*x*<sub>*p*<sub>*i*</sub></sub>

, as some decreases may have already been applied to it. The edges are numbered from

1

to

*n* - 1

in the order they appear in the input.

## Output

For each guest who chooses the operation of the first type, print the result of processing the value $*y*_{*i*}$ through the path from $*a*_{*i*}$ to $*b*_{*i*}$.

## Note

Initially the tree looks like this: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bcea9d23f26044b8c3f80ef7acb580f12d2b408e.png) The response to the first query is: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5d118e070291dffa2524a35d044ed59aa2446202.png) = 2After the third edge is changed, the tree looks like this: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73cdd0af5696182d3ab2f1221c801d03ac5e84d4.png) The response to the second query is: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e174ec48fc18590923a6011f38f9725ace276d6b.png) = 4In the third query the initial and final vertex coincide, that is, the answer will be the initial number 20.After the change in the fourth edge the tree looks like this: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8c14649b47b3622f3297b9150db434f6fa80b20.png) In the last query the answer will be: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e2fd5e66c04846639323b74047d246292d6d487.png) = 3
statementZhMd:
今天是 Bogdan 的生日，妈妈送给他一棵由 $*n*$ 个顶点组成的树。树的每条边 $*i*$ 上都写着一个数 $*x*_{*i*}$。如果你忘记了，树是一种无向连通无环图。收到礼物后，共有 $*m*$ 位客人依次来到 Bogdan 的派对上。当第 $*i*$ 位客人到来时，他会恰好执行以下两种操作之一：

1. 选择一个数 $*y*_{*i*}$，以及两个顶点 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$。然后，他沿树中从顶点 $*a*_{*i*}$ 到顶点 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的最短路径移动（当然，在树中这样的路径是唯一的）。每当他沿某条边 $*j*$ 移动时，就将当前数字 $*y*_{*i*}$ 替换为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a185f1c5e3a23a089bf689d964cc2d081c9f40ce.png)，即 $*y*_{*i*}$ div $*x*_{*j*}$ 的结果。
2. 选择一条边 $*p*_{*i*}$，并将其上写的数 $*x*_{*p*_{*i*}}$ 替换为某个正整数 $*c*_{*i*} < *x*_{*p*_{*i*}}$。

Bogdan 很关心他的客人，因此决定简化这一过程。请编写程序执行客人要求的所有操作，并对于每个执行第一类操作的客人，输出对应的结果 $*y*_{*i*}$。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 200 000$），分别表示 Bogdan 从妈妈那里收到的树的顶点数，以及来到派对的客人数。

接下来 $*n*$ - 1 行描述树中的边。其中第 $*i*$ 行包含三个整数 $*u*_{*i*}$、$*v*_{*i*}$ 和 $*x*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*} , *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$，$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{18}$），表示一条连接顶点 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$ 的边，其上初始写有数字 $*x*_{*i*}$。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行描述 Bogdan 的客人所要求的操作。每个操作包含三个或四个整数，并且有以下两种形式之一：

- $1$ $*a*_{*i*}$ $*b*_{*i*}$ $*y*_{*i*}$ 表示一位客人选择第一类操作。
- $2$ $*p*_{*i*}$ $*c*_{*i*}$ 表示一位客人选择第二类操作。

保证所有询问均合法，即：

1 ≤ *a*<sub>*i*</sub>, *b*<sub>*i*</sub> ≤ *n*

,

1 ≤ *p*<sub>*i*</sub> ≤ *n* - 1

,

1 ≤ *y*<sub>*i*</sub> ≤ 10<sup>18</sup>

以及

1 ≤ *c*<sub>*i*</sub> < *x*<sub>*p*<sub>*i*</sub></sub>

，其中

*x*<sub>*p*<sub>*i*</sub></sub>

表示边

*p*<sub>*i*</sub>

在当前时刻写着的数字，它不一定等于初始值

*x*<sub>*p*<sub>*i*</sub></sub>

，因为之前可能已经对其执行过若干次减小操作。边按照它们在输入中出现的顺序编号为

1

到

*n* - 1。

## 输出格式

对于每位选择第一类操作的客人，输出将数值 $*y*_{*i*}$ 沿从 $*a*_{*i*}$ 到 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的路径处理后的结果。

## 说明

初始时树的形态如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bcea9d23f26044b8c3f80ef7acb580f12d2b408e.png) 第一次询问的答案为：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5d118e070291dffa2524a35d044ed59aa2446202.png) = 2

第三条边修改后，树的形态如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73cdd0af5696182d3ab2f1221c801d03ac5e84d4.png) 第二次询问的答案为：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e174ec48fc18590923a6011f38f9725ace276d6b.png) = 4

在第三次询问中，起点和终点顶点重合，因此答案就是初始数字 20。

第四条边修改后，树的形态如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8c14649b47b3622f3297b9150db434f6fa80b20.png) 最后一次询问的答案为：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e2fd5e66c04846639323b74047d246292d6d487.png) = 3
